hero.title: Handcrafted with love in my small studio.
hero.subtitle: Welcome to Mumburi. A quiet space where slow, intentional craft meets everyday objects. Every piece tells a story of patience, earth, and hands.

makers.heading: Let’s grow together, friend.
makers.description: I love meeting fellow dreamers and makers. If you have a spark of an idea or want to see Mumburi pieces in your own space, I'd love to hear your story. Drop your handle below so I can admire your world.
makers.studioNoteText: We have room for 12 makers to join our hearth at once.

wholesale.title: Let’s stock your shelves together.
wholesale.description: We love partnering with boutiques and galleries that value the slow and the steady. Our wholesale program is more of a conversation than a contract. Reach out and let's chat about how Mumburi fits into your world.
wholesale.footerNote: I'D LOVE TO SEE YOUR INSTAGRAM OR PORTFOLIO LINK TOO!
